doc.title: Artie Shaw — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Touring in the second-hand Rolls-Royce Phaeton with Billie
summary: He bought a beat-up Rolls with eisenglass flaps for one-nighters and took Billie in it because she preferred not to ride with the others.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: What’s the story of this famous old Rolls Royce that you used to travel in?

It was a kick. I thought, I was going to drive, I might as well have a fancy Rolls Royce, so I bought this Phaeton with the double windshields. Billie was in that car when we hit a road one time and turned around, all ice. We’d be out on the road and the rain would be coming down. It was 32 degrees. Suddenly you’re on an ice skating rink.
